literalGroups.primaryGround: TI documents CAN identifiers and message priority (L182-L185), arbitration with dominant-bit victory (L215-L226). The non-key alternatives still require source-backed plausibility/category review; LIN note is terminal HOLD and OBD-II category remains open.

literalGroups.literal: Шина CAN — приоритетная многомастерная сеть без отдельного центрального адресата сообщения. Она передаёт данные всем узлам, а каждый узел фильтрует ненужные ему сообщения.
literalGroups.primaryGround: TI documents the identifier priority/arbitration mechanism and broadcast filtering by receiving nodes (L177-L195,L215-L226); the proposed wording is limited to those supported properties.
literalGroups.locator: L80-L85 robust protocol and control applications; L177-L195 broadcast, identifiers, priority/content-oriented addressing; L215-L226 arbitration and dominant-bit winner; L418-L422 noise filtering/EMC.

literalGroups.literal: LIN — дешёвая однопроводная сеть с одним планировщиком для простых устройств кузова.

The attempted NXP URL was an I2C manual; the official LIN specification URL was inaccessible. Both permitted requests consumed; no third request. The LIN note remains unapplied/unverified.

literalGroups.literal: Шина CAN — приоритетная многомастерная сеть без отдельного центрального адресата сообщения.
literalGroups.primaryGround: TI describes CAN as a broadcast bus, uses identifiers to prioritize messages, and shows nodes participating in arbitration; a message is available to all nodes and each node filters data it needs (L177-L195,L215-L226).

literalGroups.primaryGround: NXP/Freescale identifies FlexRay as an automotive communications protocol for advanced controls and lists time/event-triggered communication and fault-tolerant systems (L21-L40,L53-L70).
